crossRefs.note: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.
Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the…
For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your…
“You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
“The Lord Yahweh says: ‘An evil! A unique evil! Behold, it comes.
“ ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the…
The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;” ’ but tell them, ‘ “The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
translations.bsb: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will put an end to this proverb, and in Israel they will no longer recite it.’ But say to them: ‘The days are at hand when every vision will be fulfilled.
translations.kjv: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
translations.asv: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the fulfilment of every vision.
